slow = fast = head
while fast and fast.next:
    slow = slow.next
    fast = fast.next.next
    if slow == fast: break

# To find cycle START:

    slow, fast = slow.next, fast.next
return slow

dfs-tree-orders:
# Post-order: process children first, then self.
def f(node):
    if not node: return
    left  = f(node.left)
    right = f(node.right)
    # ... combine + return value upward
    return 1 + max(left, right)

uf-basic:
parent = list(range(n))
rank   = [0] * n
def find(x):
    while parent[x] != x:
        parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]   # path compression
        x = parent[x]
    return x
def union(a, b):
    ra, rb = find(a), find(b)
    if ra == rb: return False
    if rank[ra] < rank[rb]: ra, rb = rb, ra
    parent[rb] = ra
    if rank[ra] == rank[rb]: rank[ra] += 1
    return True
